title: Scaffold Client Configuration
description: Machine-readable input for the zero-day scaffold baker (Phase 2).

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for editor validation (e.g. ../scaffold.config.schema.json).

version.description: Schema version. Must be "1" for Phase 2 configs.

productName.description: Human-readable product name shown in the shell, auth screens, and metadata.

packageName.description: Optional npm-safe package slug (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens). If omitted, the baker derives one from productName.

defaultSurface.description: Default theme surface mode applied on first load.

primaryHex.description: Primary brand color as a 6-digit hex value (e.g. #3b82f6).

accentHex.description: Accent brand color as a 6-digit hex value (e.g. #6366f1).

shell.description: Admin shell navigation layout. Maps to vertical sidebar or horizontal top rail.

cardStyle.description: Default card surface treatment across dashboard and app pages.

authLayout.description: Authentication page layout. Split uses a side panel; card uses a centered card.

authMethods.description: Sign-in methods exposed on LoginPage (primary first at bake via authPrimary). At least one required.

authPrimary.description: Primary sign-in method. Defaults to the first entry of authMethods. When set explicitly, must be included in authMethods.

passwordlessMode.description: Passwordless UX mode. Only meaningful when authMethods includes passwordless.

includeRegister.description: Maps to authConfig.registerEnabled. Register routes stay mounted; Login footer and RegisterPage self-redirect when false. Meaningless for social/SSO-only.

dashboards.description: Dashboard modules to include in navigation and routing. At least one is required.

starterModules.description: Starter app modules to include. May be empty.

advancedFeatures.description: Advanced feature pages to include. Defaults to none.
